title: How to Build an Email List That Actually Brings Customers Back

segments.text: Email returns $42 for every $1 you spend.

segments.narration: Email marketing has the highest ROI of any marketing channel, $42 back for every dollar spent. No algorithm decides who sees it. No ad budget required. Your list belongs to you.

segments.title: Average Open Rate by Email Type
segments.narration: Welcome emails get a 50 percent open rate because they land right when someone signs up. Set up a welcome sequence first. Everything else builds from there.
About one in four people on your list will open every email you send. Organic social media reach often falls below 5 percent. The difference is direct access to people who already know your business.
The full guide covers building your list, what to send, and which tools to start with for free.
